plan.summary: Add a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid position opposite its current orientation without rotating it, while preserving existing board-boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to MovementOrder so turns can represent backward movement.
Add a Direction operation that returns the opposite cardinal direction for use when calculating reverse movement.
Handle REVERSE in MovementEngine.applyOrder by moving the position one cell in the opposite direction while retaining the vehicle's original orientation.

Reuse the existing position validation and simultaneous conflict resolution so reverse moves are blocked at board edges, by stationary vehicles, on shared targets, during swaps, and through blocked movement chains.

Update the game rules to list REVERSE as supported, define its vectors and orientation behavior, make boundary wording apply to both translational orders, and remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope list.
tests: Add parameterized or representative unit cases verifying reverse movement for NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, and WEST while preserving orientation.
Verify a reverse move that would leave the board is blocked and returns the original vehicle state.
Verify reverse movement participates in collision resolution, including contention with a forward-moving vehicle and movement into an occupied cell.
Run the backend test suite with ./mvnw test from the backend directory to confirm reverse behavior and all existing movement, application, and API tests pass.
